plugin_desc: Versa Networks SD-WAN 路由器（FlexVNF / VOS）SNMP 采集模板（DEVICE-MIB，企业号 42359）。识别门控为 sysObjectID 前缀 1.3.6.1.4.1.42359。采集 deviceTable 列：CPU 使用率（deviceCPULoad，0–100%）、内存使用率（deviceMemoryLoad，0–100%），以及活动/失败/最大会话（deviceActiveSessions / deviceFailedSessions / deviceMaxSessions）。索引按 deviceClientId（及 ifIndex）walk 发现，禁止把 device 节点或假标量当 CPU/内存叶。接口流量走内置 IF-MIB，本插件不声明 ifHC*。Versa SD-WAN 以软件型/虚拟化网络功能（VNF）运行于通用计算或白盒 CPE 之上，其私有 MIB 未以无需行级过滤的标量形式暴露温度/风扇/电源传感器，故为 N/A。
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Versa SD-WAN router (DEVICE-MIB deviceCPULoad, 0-100 percent, averaged across deviceTable rows).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Versa SD-WAN router (DEVICE-MIB deviceMemoryLoad, 0-100 percent, averaged across deviceTable rows).

metrics.name: device_active_sessions
metrics.description: Active sessions on the Versa SD-WAN router (DEVICE-MIB deviceActiveSessions), summed across deviceTable rows.

metrics.name: device_failed_sessions
metrics.description: Failed sessions on the Versa SD-WAN router (DEVICE-MIB deviceFailedSessions), summed across deviceTable rows.

metrics.name: device_max_sessions
metrics.description: Session capacity of the Versa SD-WAN router (DEVICE-MIB deviceMaxSessions), summed across deviceTable rows.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
